i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-x\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-y\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            ny = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-z\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nz = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;\n    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;\n    \n    printf(\"3D Stencil Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\\n\", nx, ny, nz);\n    printf(\"Iterations: %d\\n\", iterations);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    size_t gridSize = nx * ny * nz;\n    \n    // Allocate grids (double buffering)\n    std::vector<Real> grid1(gridSize);\n    std::vector<Real> grid2(gridSize);\n    \n    // Initialize\n    printf(\"Initializing grid...\\n\");\n    initializeGrid(grid1, nx, ny, nz);\n    \n    // Run stencil iterations\n    printf(\"Running stencil computation...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    for (int iter = 0;  // message travelling to rank + 1\nconstexpr int kTagToLower = 1;  // message travelling to rank - 1\n\n// 3D index calculation\ninline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {\n    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n}\n\n// Contiguous block of global z-planes owned by one rank\nstruct Slab {\n    size_t z0;      // first owned global z-plane\n    size_t nLocal;  // number of owned z-planes (zero for surplus ranks)\n    size_t active;  // number of ranks that own at least one plane\n};\n\nSlab makeSlab(const size_t rank, const size_t size, const size_t nz) {\n    const size_t active = std::max<size_t>(1, std::min(size, nz));\n    if (rank >= active) {\n        return {nz, 0, active};\n    }\n    const size_t base = nz / active;\n    const size_t rem = nz % active;\n    return {rank * base + std::min(rank, rem), base + (rank < rem ? 1 : 0), active};\n}\n\n// Local storage holds the owned planes at local indices [1, nLocal],\n// with one halo plane below (index 0) and above (index nLocal + 1).\nvoid initializeSlab(std::vector<Real>& grid, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz, const Slab& slab) {\n    for (size_t lz = 1; lz <= slab.nLocal; ++lz) {\n        const size_t z = slab.z0 + lz - 1;\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                grid[idx3(x, y, lz, nx, ny)] = (idx % 19) * 1.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    (void)nz;\n}\n\n// 7-point stencil for one global z-plane. `in` and `out` point at the first\n// element of that plane; y + 1 < ny; ++y) {\n        out[y * nx] = in[y * nx];\n        out[y * nx + nx - 1] = in[y * nx + nx - 1];\n    }\n\n    // Interior points (same summation order as the original kernel)\n    for (size_t y = 1; y + 1 < ny; ++y) {\n        for (size_t x = 1; x + 1 < nx; ++x) {\n            const size_t idx = y * nx + x;\n\n            const Real center = in[idx];\n            const Real left = in[idx - 1];\n            const Real right = in[idx + 1];\n            const Real front = in[idx - nx];\n            const Real back = in[idx + nx];\n            const Real bottom = in[idx - plane];\n            const Real top = in[idx + plane];\n\n            // Simple averaging stencil\n            out[idx] = (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// One sweep over this rank's slab. Halo planes of `in` are refreshed from the\n// neighbouring ranks first; interior planes are computed while those messages\n// are in flight.\nvoid stencilIteration(Real* in, Real* out, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                      const Slab& slab, const int rank) {\n    if (slab.nLocal == 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    const size_t plane = nx * ny;\n    const int planeCount = static_cast<int>(plane);\n    const size_t last = slab.nLocal;  // local index of the last owned plane\n    const bool hasLower = rank > 0;\n    const bool hasUpper = static_cast<size_t>(rank) + 1 < slab.active;\n\n    MPI_Request reqs[4];\n    int nReq = 0;\n    if (hasLower) {\n        MPI_Irecv(in, planeCount, MPI_DOUBLE, rank - 1, kTagToUpper, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqs[nReq++]);\n        MPI_Isend(in + plane, planeCount, MPI_DOUBLE, rank - 1, kTagToLower, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqs[nReq++]);\n    }\n    if (hasUpper) {\n        MPI_Irecv(in + (last + 1) * plane, planeCount, MPI_DOUBLE, rank + 1, kTagToLower, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqs[nReq++]);\n        MPI_Isend(in + last * plane, planeCount, MPI_DOUBLE, rank + 1, kTagToUpper, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqs[nReq++]);\n    }\n\n    // Planes 2 .. last-1 only read owned data\n    for (size_t lz = 2; lz < last; ++lz) {\n        updatePlane(in + lz * plane, out + lz * plane, nx, ny, slab.z0 + lz - 1, nz);\n    }\n\n    MPI_Waitall(nReq, reqs, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n\n    // Planes that need the halos\n    updatePlane(in + plane, out + plane, nx, ny, slab.z0, nz);\n    if (last > 1) {\n        updatePlane(in + last * plane, out + last * plane, nx, ny, slab.z0 + last - 1, nz);\n    }\n}\n\n// Global min/max and NaN/Inf check over all ranks' owned values\nbool validateResult(const Real* owned, const size_t count, const bool root) {\n    // 1. be set to nx if not specified\n    int iterations = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-x\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-y\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            ny = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-z\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nz = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;\n    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;\n\n    if (nx == 0) {\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Grid size must be greater than zero\\n\");\n        }\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    const size_t plane = nx * ny;\n    if (plane > INT_MAX || nz > INT_MAX) {\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Grid plane (nx * ny) and nz must each be at most %d\\n\", INT_MAX);\n        }\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"3D Stencil Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\\n\", nx, ny, nz);\n        printf(\"Iterations: %d\\n\", iterations);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d\\n\", size);\n    }\n\n    const size_t gridSize = nx * ny * nz;\n    const Slab slab = makeSlab(static_cast<size_t>(rank), static_cast<size_t>(size), nz);\n\n    // Local blocks (double buffering), including halo planes\n    std::vector<Real> grid1((slab.nLocal + 2) * plane);\n    std::vector<Real> grid2((slab.nLocal + 2)      printf(\"Running stencil computation...\\n\");\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        if // Calculate performance metrics\n        double cellUpdates = (double)((nx-2) * (ny-2) * (nz-2)) * iterations;\n        double mcups = cellUpdates / (durationMs / 1000.0) / 1e6;  // Million cell std::vector<Real> fullGrid(root ? gridSize : 0);\n        MPI_Gatherv(finalOwned, static_cast<int>(slab.nLocal), planeType,\n                    fullGrid.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(),  // message travelling to rank + 1\nconstexpr int kTagToLower = 1;  // message travelling to rank - 1\n\n// 3D index calculation\ninline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {\n    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n}\n\n// Contiguous block of global z-planes owned by one rank\nstruct Slab {\n    size_t z0;      // first owned global z-plane\n    size_t nLocal;  // number of owned z-planes (zero for surplus ranks)\n    size_t active;  // number of ranks that own at least one plane\n};\n\nSlab makeSlab(const size_t rank, const size_t size, const size_t nz) {\n    const size_t active = std::max<size_t>(1, std::min(size, nz));\n    if (rank >= active) {\n        return {nz, 0, active};\n    }\n    const size_t base = nz / active;\n    const size_t rem = nz % active;\n    return {rank * base + std::min(rank, rem), base + (rank < rem ? 1 : 0), active};\n}\n\n// Local storage holds the owned planes at local indices [1, nLocal],\n// with one halo plane below (index 0) and above (index nLocal + 1).\nvoid initializeSlab(std::vector<Real>& grid, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz, const Slab& slab) {\n    for (size_t lz = 1; lz <= slab.nLocal; ++lz) {\n        const size_t z = slab.z0 + lz - 1;\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                grid[idx3(x, y, lz, nx, ny)] = (idx % 19) * 1.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    (void)nz;\n}\n\n// 7-point stencil for one global z-plane. `in` and `out` point at the first\n// element of that plane; Halo planes of `in` are refreshed from the\n// neighbouring ranks first; interior planes are computed while those messages\n// are in flight.\nvoid stencilIteration(Real* in, Real* out, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                      const Slab& slab, const int rank) {\n    if (slab.nLocal == 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    const size_t plane = nx * ny;\n    const int planeCount = static_cast<int>(plane);\n    const size_t last = slab.nLocal;  // local index of the last owned plane\n    const bool hasLower = rank > 0;\n    const bool hasUpper = static_cast<size_t>(rank) + 1 < slab.active;\n\n    MPI_Request reqs[4];\n    int nReq = 0;\n    if (hasLower) {\n        MPI_Irecv(in, planeCount, MPI_DOUBLE, rank - 1, kTagToUpper, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqs[nReq++]);\n        MPI_Isend(in + plane, planeCount, MPI_DOUBLE, rank - 1, kTagToLower, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqs[nReq++]);\n    }\n    if (hasUpper) {\n        MPI_Irecv(in + (last + 1) * plane, planeCount, MPI_DOUBLE, rank + 1, kTagToLower, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqs[nReq++]);\n        MPI_Isend(in + last * plane, planeCount, MPI_DOUBLE, rank + 1, kTagToUpper, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqs[nReq++]);\n    }\n\n    // Planes 2 .. last-1 only read owned data\n    for (size_t lz = 2; lz < last; ++lz) {\n        updatePlane(in + lz * plane, out + lz * plane, nx, ny, slab.z0 + lz - 1, nz);\n    }\n\n    MPI_Waitall(nReq, reqs, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n\n    // Planes that need the halos\n    updatePlane(in + plane, out + plane, nx, ny, slab.z0, nz);\n    if (last > 1) {\n        updatePlane(in + last * plane, out + last * plane, nx, ny, slab.z0 + last - 1, nz);\n    }\n}\n\n// Global min/max and NaN/Inf check over all ranks' owned values\nbool validateResult(const Real* owned, const size_t count, const bool root) {\n    // 1.  // message travelling to rank + 1\nconstexpr int kTagToLower = 1;  // message travelling to rank - 1\n\n// 3D index calculation\ninline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {\n    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n}\n\n// Contiguous block of global z-planes owned by one rank\nstruct Slab {\n    size_t z0;      // first owned global z-plane\n    size_t nLocal;  // number of owned z-planes (zero for surplus ranks)\n    size_t active;  // number of ranks that own at least one plane\n};\n\nSlab makeSlab(const size_t rank, const size_t size, const size_t nz) {\n    const size_t active = std::max<size_t>(1, std::min(size, nz));\n    if (rank >= active) {\n        return {nz, 0, active};\n    }\n    const size_t base = nz / active;\n    const size_t rem = nz % active;\n    return {rank * base + std::min(rank, rem), base + (rank < rem ? 1 : 0), active};\n}\n\n// Local storage holds the owned planes at local indices [1, nLocal],\n// with one halo plane below (index 0) and above (index nLocal + 1).\nvoid initializeSlab(std::vector<Real>& grid, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const Slab& slab) {\n    for (size_t lz = 1; lz <= slab.nLocal; ++lz) {\n        const size_t z = slab.z0 + lz - 1;\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                grid[idx3(x, y, lz, nx, ny)] = (idx % 19) * 1.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    (void)nz;\n}\n\n// 7-point stencil for one global z-plane. `in` and `out` point at the first\n// element of that plane; the planes at z - 1 and z + 1 must be addressable\n// (halo planes supply them across rank boundaries).\nvoid updatePlane(const Real* in, Real* out, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t z, const size_t nz) {\n    const size_t plane = nx * ny;\n    if (z == 0 || z == nz - 1) {\n        // Global boundary plane: copied unchanged\n        std::copy(in, in + plane, out);\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // Boundary rows and columns of an interior plane are copied unchanged\n    std::copy(in, in + nx, out);\n    std::copy(in + (ny - 1) * nx, in + plane, out + (ny - 1) * nx);\n    for (size_t y = 1; y + 1 < ny; ++y) {\n        out[y * nx] = in[y * nx];\n        out[y * nx + nx - 1] = in[y * nx + nx - 1];\n    }\n\n    // Interior points (same summation order as the original kernel)\n    for (size_t y = 1; y + 1 < ny; ++y) {\n        for (size_t x = 1; x + 1 < nx; ++x) {\n            const size_t idx = y * nx + x;\n\n            const Real center = in[idx];\n            const Real left = in[idx - 1];\n            const Real right = in[idx + 1];\n            const Real front = in[idx - nx];\n            const Real back = in[idx + nx];\n            const Real bottom = in[idx - plane];\n            const Real top = in[idx + plane];\n\n            // Simple averaging stencil\n            out[idx] = (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// One sweep over this rank's slab. Halo planes of `in` are refreshed from the\n// neighbouring ranks first; interior planes are computed while those messages\n// are in flight.\nvoid stencilIteration(Real* in, Real* out, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                      const Slab& slab, const int rank) {\n    if (slab.nLocal == 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    const size_t plane = nx * ny;\n    const int planeCount = static_cast<int>(plane);\n    const size_t last = slab.nLocal;  // local index of the last owned plane\n    const bool hasLower = rank > 0;\n    const bool hasUpper = static_cast<size_t>(rank) + 1 < slab.active;\n\n    MPI_Request reqs[4];\n    int nReq = 0;\n    if (hasLower) {\n        MPI_Irecv(in, planeCount, MPI_DOUBLE, rank - 1, kTagToUpper, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqs[nReq++]);\n        MPI_Isend(in + plane, planeCount, MPI_DOUBLE, rank - 1, kTagToLower, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqs[nReq++]);\n    }\n    if (hasUpper) {\n        MPI_Irecv(in + (last + 1) * plane, planeCount, MPI_DOUBLE, rank + 1, kTagToLower, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqs[nReq++]);\n        MPI_Isend(in + last * plane, planeCount, MPI_DOUBLE, rank + 1, kTagToUpper, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqs[nReq++]);\n    }\n\n    // Planes 2 .. last-1 only read owned data\n    for (size_t lz = 2; lz < last; ++lz) {\n        updatePlane(in + lz * plane, out + lz * plane, nx, ny, slab.z0 + lz - 1, nz);\n    }\n\n    MPI_Waitall(nReq, reqs, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n\n    // Planes that need the halos\n    updatePlane(in + plane, out + plane, nx, ny, slab.z0, nz);\n    if (last > 1) {\n        updatePlane(in + last * plane, out + last * plane, nx, ny, slab.z0 + last - 1, nz);\n    }\n}\n\n// Global min/max and NaN/Inf check over all ranks' owned values\nbool validateResult(const Real* owned, const size_t count, const bool root) {\n    // 1. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfxg4fQGGSN93U1bE2Jxn","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The stencil3d benchmark now runs under MPI unconditionally. Its output matches the original bit-for-bit across 72 test cases.\n\n**What changed** (only `stencil3d/stencil3d.cpp` and `stencil3d/CMakeLists.txt`; the executable name is still `stencil3d`)\n\n- **Decomposition:** 1D slabs along z. Each rank owns a contiguous block of z-planes plus one halo plane on each side. Ranks beyond `nz` own nothing and sit idle.\n- **Communication:** each iteration, neighbours exchange one halo plane each way with non-blocking sends and receives. Planes that don't touch a halo are computed while the messages are in flight. Planes are contiguous in memory, so nothing is packed.\n- **Memory:** each rank stores only its slab, so the total footprint is split across ranks.\n- **Gather:** the full grid is only gathered to rank 0 when `-r` is given, because the hash, Kahan sum and sample output depend on global order.\n- **Validation:** done with reductions (NaN/Inf count, global min and max), so `-v` does not gather the grid.\n- **Timing:** the reported time is the slowest rank's wall time for the iteration loop, measured after a barrier.\n- **Output:** only rank 0 prints, and the text format is unchanged.\n- **Kernel:** the stencil keeps the original summation order, so results are bit-identical.\n- **CMake:** `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` and links `MPI::MPI_CXX`. No other dependencies were added.\n\n**Verification**\n\n- Built cleanly with `-Wall -Wextra`, no warnings, using CMake out-of-tree in `/tmp`.\n- Compared against the original binary for 1, 2, 3, 4, 7 and 16 ranks. Cases covered non-cubic grids, 0 and 1 iterations, odd and even iteration counts, single-plane and two-plane grids, and more ranks than planes. Every `-r` result block and `-v` outcome matched, and exit codes matched.\n- Timing on a single node, 512³, 10 iterations: the original runs at about 420 MCell-updates/s; 4 ranks reach about 2640, 8 about 2850, 16 about 2950, and 32 about 3020. Beyond 4 ranks the gain is small, which points to this node's memory bandwidth as the limit. I did not test across multiple nodes.\n\n**Choices you may want to revisit**\n\n- A slab decomposition limits useful ranks to `nz`.
